title: Birch & Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: The rank of an elliptic curve's rational points equals the order of vanishing of its L-function at s=1.
detail:
\[\operatorname{ord}_{s=1}L(E,s)=\operatorname{rank}(E(\mathbb{Q}))\]

Proved for rank 0 and 1 in special cases (Coates–Wiles, Kolyvagin). The full conjecture is open. Clay Millennium Prize Problem.
